stories.title: Bulog Bidik Serapan Beras Tembus 130 Persen di Akhir 2026

en.title: Bulog Targets Rice Absorption Exceeding 130 Percent by End of 2026
en.summary: State logistics agency Bulog projects domestic rice absorption will reach 130 percent of government targets by end of 2026, with current absorption already at 102 percent or over 4 million tons.

stories.title: Calvin Verdonk langsung fokus untuk Lille setelah bawa Indonesia juara

en.title: Calvin Verdonk Immediately Focuses on Lille After Leading Indonesia to Championship
en.summary: Indonesian national team left-back Calvin Verdonk shifted his focus to his club Lille after helping his country achieve a championship victory.

stories.title: Polisi Tangkap Dua Pelaku Pembunuhan Wanita di Jaktim

en.title: Police Arrest Two Suspects in Woman's Murder in East Jakarta
en.summary: Metro Jaya Police arrested two suspects in connection with the murder of a woman in Jakarta, with the motive believed to be related to economic factors and possession of the victim's property.

stories.title: Serapan gabah dan beras Bulog Karawang tembus 92,41 ribu ton

en.title: Bulog Karawang Rice and Paddy Absorption Reaches 92.41 Thousand Tons
en.summary: Bulog's branch office in Karawang Regency, West Java has absorbed 92.41 thousand tons of paddy and rice.

en.title: Mount Anak Krakatau Eruptions Intensify, Alert Level Raised to 'Watch'
en.summary: Mount Anak Krakatau's volcanic activity has intensified, prompting authorities to raise its alert level. The volcano's status was recently downgraded to Level II before this escalation.

stories.title: Indonesia drafts decree to transfer Whoosh shares to Finance Ministry

en.summary: Belgian tennis player Elise Mertens defeated eighth-seeded Iga Swiatek 7-6 (7-0), 6-3 to advance to the China Open semifinals.

en.title: Digitalization of hajj pilgrim services based on data closes fraud gaps
en.summary: The Ministry of Hajj and Umrah partnered with the Ministry of Home Affairs to sign a joint circular addressing the digitalization of hajj services through data-based systems to prevent irregularities.

en.title: Mount Anak Krakatau Alert Status Raised to Level III
